contentList.content:
Focus the strength of your will on dousing the Pyre.

The Pyre Equilibrium of your target falls by [1] for the rest of the fight.
The Pyre burning on every other enemy falls by [2].

Pass a Charisma Saving Throw and you recover the Action and Bonus Action spent on it. The refund happens once per turn.

Gather your will into a fist and destroy the hold of the Pyre on this fight.

With a [1]% chance a random piece of your equipment burns with it.

Available only while you wear at least [2] items of Rare quality or better.

Destroy part of the Pyre. All enemies lose half of their Pyre levels and can no longer build it up.

It costs your whole turn and the next one: you cannot act or move until the end of your next turn. Pass a Wisdom Saving Throw and you keep the next turn.

A fight can be subdued only once, by a single character: afterwards the button leaves the whole party.

Available only once the Pyre of at least one enemy has reached its Equilibrium.

Cannot take an <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ActionPoint">Action</LSTag>, a <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="BonusActionPoint">Bonus Action</LSTag> or move. Lasts until the end of the next turn.
